selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline discovery: existing data owned by root, world-readable, no inventorysvc/inventory-readers present
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/inventory and its files were root:root with 755/644 perms; inventorysvc user did not exist
sha256sum of config.json and records.csv captured before changes and matched sha256sum after chown/chmod, proving content preservation
Created inventorysvc system user, chown -R to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, verified via ls -la showing inventorysvc as owner on all paths
Created inventory-readers group, applied as group owner with 750/640 perms; a test user added to inventory-readers successfully read records.csv (rc=0)
Non-privileged shell user 'antrieb' got Permission denied listing the directory; user 'nobody' (not in inventory-readers) got Permission denied reading records.csv (rc=1)

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a and confirmed /srv/inventory perms/ownership/checksums healthy immediately before reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via nohup; exec call returned 'reboot issued' with exit_code 0 before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - proof of disconnection and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Subsequent exec timed out (node down mid-reboot); later poll succeeded with new boot_id f813c49b-7e9a-4d7d-a782-c488aa58ecbf, differing from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - post-restart recovery of required state
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, /srv/inventory ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), and file checksums matched pre-restart baseline exactly; access control re-verified (inventorysvc allowed, nobody denied)
